notes: This catalog slice tracks active-cooled NVIDIA Turing GPUs with 24 GB of addressable GDDR6 that remain useful for local LLM inference on the secondary market.

Manufacturer specifications are authoritative for architecture, memory, bandwidth, power and interfaces. Marketplace prices are point-in-time asking-price observations, not fair-market-value guarantees.

NVIDIA currently lists TITAN RTX and Quadro RTX 6000 as compute capability 7.5 devices in its CUDA GPU table. Turing therefore has a materially better current CUDA position than Maxwell, Pascal and Volta, but application-level support still depends on framework builds and kernel requirements.
Model-fit guidance is approximate because quantization format, context length, KV cache, runtime overhead and CPU/RAM offload affect usable capacity.

hardware.nvlink: 2-way; NVIDIA states paired TITAN RTX cards can expose 48 GB effective GPU memory to supported applications with up to 100 GB/s NVLink transfer bandwidth
software: vLLM where Turing-compatible kernels/builds are used
hardware.quantization_compatibility: Strong compatibility with common CUDA-backed GGUF, GPTQ, AWQ and other weight-only quantized inference paths, subject to the selected runtime still compiling and shipping kernels for compute capability 7.5.
hardware.model_size_practicality: 24 GB is comfortable for many 7B-20B class quantized models and some larger models with aggressive quantization. Many 30B-class 4-bit weights are near the practical capacity boundary once KV cache and runtime overhead are included, so exact fit must be tested.
hardware.llm_inference_suitability: High. The combination of 24 GB VRAM, 672 GB/s bandwidth, active desktop cooling and a still-current CUDA compute-capability listing makes TITAN RTX easier to operate than passive datacenter bargains of similar capacity.

performance_per_watt.basis: 672 GB/s divided by NVIDIA 280 W TDP; this is a specification ratio, not measured LLM tokens per watt.

cost_efficiency.basis: Representative eBay Canada localized used listing observed 2026-08-23; shipping, taxes, seller location and condition vary.

hardware.off_grid_suitability: low-medium; 280 W GPU power is substantial, but active cooling and 24 GB capacity can make it more practical than server cards when total integration effort matters.

pricing.note: Representative pre-owned TITAN RTX 24GB listing. Other listings observed around CA$1,145-1,250; asking prices are not completed-sale valuations.

hardware.form_factor: 4.4 in high x 10.5 in long, dual-slot workstation reference card
hardware.cooling: active on workstation reference/OEM variants; passive server variants also exist and require directed airflow
hardware.nvlink: 2-way; NVIDIA documents up to 48 GB combined GDDR6 and 100 GB/s bidirectional transfer bandwidth for supported applications
hardware.quantization_compatibility: Strong compatibility with common CUDA-backed GGUF and weight-only quantization runtimes when the selected build retains compute capability 7.5 kernels. ECC memory can be useful for long-running workstation/server deployments.
hardware.model_size_practicality: 24 GB is comfortable for many 7B-20B quantized models and selected larger models. 30B-class 4-bit operation is configuration dependent because model weights, KV cache and runtime buffers compete for the same VRAM.
hardware.llm_inference_suitability: High for a used Turing workstation card. It combines the same 672 GB/s class memory subsystem as TITAN RTX with ECC and professional-driver positioning, but seller listings must be checked carefully for passive server variants.

performance_per_watt.basis: 672 GB/s divided by NVIDIA 295 W total board power; specification ratio only.

cost_efficiency.basis: Representative eBay Canada localized pre-owned listing observed 2026-08-23; shipping/import costs vary materially.

hardware.off_grid_suitability: low; nearly 300 W board power plus host load, though active workstation variants avoid the additional blower/duct engineering required by passive datacenter cards.

pricing.note: Representative pre-owned Quadro RTX 6000 24GB listing at CA$1,336.25 before CA$312.81 shipping. Other active/passive variants were observed at different prices; cooling implementation must be verified before purchase.
